title: Who Really Benefits From Extended Car Warranties—You or the Dealership?
summary: A personal-finance blog concludes dealerships, not buyers, usually benefit most from extended car warranties once markup, exclusions and low usage are considered.

assertions.quote: who really benefits from extended car warranties? In most cases, it's the dealership

verdicts.note: True on average given markups and low usage rates, but some buyers with unreliable, high-mileage or expensive-to-repair cars do come out ahead.

assertions.quote: sometimes as much as 100% over what the warranty company charges the dealer
Routine maintenance, wear-and-tear items like brakes and tires, and cosmetic repairs are typically not covered
consider setting up a dedicated car repair fund
an extended warranty might not add much value until that original coverage expires
